svg.title: Diagram, how a change moves: How a change moves · 13 agents · 5 stages · UNDERSTAND: Understand. An unclear request becomes a plan. planner · PRODUCE: Produce. The owning specialist builds it. backend, database, frontend, devops · AUDIT: Audit. Checked before anything lands. security, privacy, test, performance, refuter · CLOSE: Close. A clean review, then your approval. review, commit · HAND OFF: Hand off. State saved for the next session. session · Nothing is committed until the audit is clean and you approve it.
